title: The content tree creation round (census 890)

banner.title: The content tree creation - the skeleton lands, the monsters move
banner.provenance: The content-structure arc round two: the content/ skeleton lands via thirteen .keep data files (rules, npcs, items, items/artifacts, spells, tables, tiles, objects, world and its three world buckets plus the karatur expansion bucket), and the monster Lua registry moves from monsters/monsters to content/monsters by the user-side git mv - the loader path rewritten in six places (adnd1.cpp the loadDirectory call and its error string, regtest.cpp the loader walk and its R71fix comment, tools/normalize_registry.py its docstring, and the R314 engine audit fragment's letter-dir load). The registry and xp code stays in monsters/ - C++ never enters the content tree (the R966 charter).
